noun.en: The adjective uncivil means impolite, and we have a similar noun that's incivility.
noun.zh: 形容词 uncivil 意为不礼貌，我们有一个相似的名词是 incivility。

noun.en: A pale, P-A-L-E, as a noun, is literally a fenced boundary, an enclosure.
noun.zh: “Pale”这个词作为名词，字面意思是栅栏边界或围场。

noun.en: The noun liveability means the degree to which a place is pleasant to live in.
noun.zh: 名词“宜居性”指一个地方适合居住的舒适程度。

noun.en: A shift is a small change. It can be used as a verb or a noun.
noun.zh: 改变（shift）是一个小变化。它可以用作动词或名词。

noun.en: And just to note, the noun that goes with this is incivility.
noun.zh: 顺便提一下，与此配套的名词是incivility（不文明）。

normally.en: Normally “yes” or “no”. They’re useful when you need something clear and specific.
normally.zh: 通常是“是”或“否”。当你需要明确且具体的事情时，它们非常有用。

normally.en: The adjective, abnormal, means different from what would normally be expected, in a bad way.
normally.zh: 形容词“异常的”（abnormal），指与正常预期不同，且是不好的方面。

normally.en: Using advanced vocabulary normally comes from repeated exposure to words in context.
normally.zh: 使用高级词汇通常来自于在语境中对单词的反复接触。

normally.en: Cheating in sport through the use of performance-enhancing drugs, informally called doping, is normally considered wrong.
normally.zh: 在体育运动中通过使用兴奋剂（通常称为doping）来作弊，通常被认为是错误的。

normally.en: This is very unusual because these maps are normally only changed after the census every 10 years.
normally.zh: 这非常不寻常，因为这些地图通常只在每10年一次的人口普查之后才会更改。

notice.en: You can notice patterns. You learn vocabulary, and you can recognize the grammar instinctively.
notice.zh: 你可以注意到规律。你学会了词汇，并且能够本能地识别语法。

notice.en: You can improve over time because there are things to notice, remember, and predict.
notice.zh: 随着时间的推移，你可以进步，因为有东西可以去注意、去记住、去预测。

notice.en: In those moments, it's important to look up to notice we are inside a tunnel.
notice.zh: 在那些时刻，抬头注意到我们正身处隧道之中至关重要。

notice.en: Pitchblende was radioactive, and Marie noticed that it was actually more radioactive than uranium.
notice.zh: 沥青铀矿具有放射性，玛丽注意到它的放射性实际上比铀还要强。

notice.en: What could happen? In the short term, we might not notice much of an impact.
notice.zh: 可能会发生什么？在短期内，我们可能不会注意到太大的影响。

normal.en: Instead of 5 years being the normal waiting period, 10 years will become the starting point.
normal.zh: 正常等待期将不再是5年，而是以10年作为起点。

normal.en: Surveillance has become such a normal part of life that it fades into the background.
normal.zh: 监控已经成为生活中如此平常的一部分，以至于它淡入了背景之中。

normal.en: Polish soldiers and normal people resisted, but Warsaw was surrounded by German forces.
normal.zh: 波兰士兵和普通民众进行了抵抗，但华沙被德军包围了。

normal.en: It happens in public, quietly and constantly, as people go about their normal routines.
normal.zh: 它发生在公共场合，在人们进行日常活动时，悄无声息且持续不断地进行着。

normal.en: Can otherwise normal, rational people, be turned into monsters, if placed in particular circumstances?
normal.zh: 原本正常、理性的人，如果被置于特定的环境中，会不会变成怪物？

noisy.en: So, it's counterintuitive, but you can make a park less noisy by adding some calmer sounds.
noisy.zh: 所以，这违反直觉，但你可以通过添加一些更平静的声音来让公园不那么吵。

noisy.en: For me, it's being very noisy when you do it.
noisy.zh: 对我来说，就是吃饭时发出很大的声音。

noisy.en: Listen to Mumbai native Chhavi Sachdev share her experiences of living in this noisy city with BBC World Service programme People Fixing the World.
noisy.zh: 听听孟买本地人Chhavi Sachdev与BBC世界频道节目《拯救世界的人们》分享她在喧闹城市生活的经历。

novel.en: Some people argue that later European works fit the definition of a novel more clearly.
novel.zh: 一些人认为后来的欧洲作品更清楚地符合小说的定义。

novel.en: The novel caused immediate and widespread offence among Muslim communities around the world.
novel.zh: 这部小说在世界各地的穆斯林群体中引起了立即且广泛的冒犯感。

novel.en: A novel is a long fictional prose narrative with developed characters and a complex story.
novel.zh: 小说是一部具有成熟人物和复杂情节的长篇虚构散文叙事。

novel.en: In September 1988, Salman Rushdie published a novel called The Satanic Verses.
novel.zh: 1988 年 9 月，Salman Rushdie 出版了一部名为《The Satanic Verses》的小说。

novel.en: Yeah. And I really loved fantasy novels.
novel.zh: 对。而且我真的很喜欢奇幻小说。

northern.en: I’m saying England because Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland already have their own power.
northern.zh: 我之所以说英格兰，是因为苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰已经拥有了属于他们自己的权力。

northern.en: The United Kingdom is formed of four countries: England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland.
northern.zh: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国由四个国家组成：英格兰、威尔士、苏格兰和北爱尔兰。

northern.en: So Noah’s from Northern California, and he was raised by his mom, a nurse.
northern.zh: 所以诺亚来自北加州，他是被当护士的妈妈抚养长大的。

northern.en: This means that there are regional parliaments in Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
northern.zh: 这意味着苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰都有地区议会。

northern.en: In places like northern Italy, new city-states were booming with merchants, bankers and notaries.
northern.zh: 在意大利北部等地，新兴的城邦里商贾云集，银行家和公证人活跃。

noticeable.en: These achievements have helped Chantel stand out – to be more noticeable and better than other chefs.
noticeable.zh: 这些成就帮助 Chantel stand out——也就是比其他厨师更引人注目、更优秀。

noticeable.en: And finally, to stand out means to be more noticeable or better than other similar things.
noticeable.zh: 最后，to stand out 意思是比其他类似的事物更引人注目或更好。

novelty.en: I think it's a novelty for now and people will drift away from it.
novelty.zh: 我认为这目前只是一种新鲜感，人们会逐渐远离它。

novelty.en: A novelty is something which is new and unusual and therefore exciting.
novelty.zh: 新鲜事物（A novelty）是指新颖、不寻常并因此令人兴奋的东西。

novelty.en: And it's an unappreciated idea for its novelty, because through most of human history, people thought of themselves as pawns.
novelty.zh: 而这种理念的新颖之处却没有得到应有的重视，因为在人类历史的大部分时间里，人们都把自己看作是棋盘上的棋子。

novelty.en: And he makes an especially pointed point about consistency because in my opinion, it's one of the most difficult of the virtues for humans to do because we're so attracted to novelty.
novelty.zh: 他特别强调了坚持，因为在我看来，这是人类最难做到的美德之一，因为我们太被新奇事物所吸引了。

novelty.en: But, toward the end of his life, he was really struggling with this idea of novelty: that, if that is true, then under what circumstances can we say something is truly new to the world?
novelty.zh: 但到了晚年，他其实一直在苦苦思索“新颖性”这个问题：如果上述说法成立，那么在什么条件下，我们才能说某样东西对这个世界来说是真正全新的？

nowadays.en: Well, nowadays, grown-ups playing with toys is more common than you might think.
nowadays.zh: 嗯，如今成年人玩玩具比你想象的还要常见。

nowadays.en: Nowadays, you can visit two McDonald’s on opposite sides of the planet and eat exactly the same meal.
nowadays.zh: 如今，你可以在地球的寶相相反的两端去到两家 McDonald’s，并吃到完全相同的饭。

nowadays.en: One thing. Sure. Yeah, totally. I have heard that nowadays, that you don't have to necessarily analyze Scripture anymore.
nowadays.zh: 就一件事。当然。好，完全可以。我听说现在，你已经不必非得去剖析经文了。

nowadays.en: I'm Phil. And I'm Beth. Nowadays, I often see people carrying water bottles with them to make sure they drink enough.
nowadays.zh: 我是Phil。我是Beth。现在，我经常看到人们随身携带水瓶，以确保喝够水。

nowadays.en: A great resort of gallants is an unusual phrase, and not something you'd hear nowadays, but it just means a fashionable crowd.
nowadays.zh: “大量时髦的上流社会人士”（A great resort of gallants）是一个不寻常的短语，现在已经听不到了，但它其实就是指时髦的人群。

nonsense.en: He had described theology as, and I quote, “a rhapsody of ill-invented nonsense”.
nonsense.zh: 他将神学描述为（我引用原话）“一首胡编乱造的无稽之谈狂想曲”。

nonsense.en: We'll put it. It's just nonsense. Co-sleeping has been around since the dawn of time.
nonsense.zh: 我们把它放那。这简直是胡说八道。同床睡从人类诞生之初就存在了。

nonsense.en: You know, it's nonsense. And it also constrains my time and it's just work.
nonsense.zh: 你知道，这很荒谬。而且它限制了我的时间，这纯粹是工作。

nonsense.en: And if something is described as hogwash, it's nonsense or not true.
nonsense.zh: 如果某事被描述为 hogwash，那就是胡说八道或并非事实。

nonsense.en: She says that many claims are hogwash: they are nonsense, and products are not worth spending money on.
nonsense.zh: 她说许多说法都是一派胡言（hogwash）：纯属无稽之谈，这些产品根本不值得花钱去买。

nowhere.en: It had nowhere to run. Suddenly it lashed out and threw itself at me.
nowhere.zh: 它无路可逃了。突然，它发起狠来，朝我扑了过来。

nowhere.en: And they began to enforce strict rules—rules that seemed to come out of nowhere.
nowhere.zh: 他们还开始执行一些严苛的规矩——那些规矩似乎凭空冒出来的。

nowhere.en: Entire neighborhoods had been demolished, and the people living in those neighborhoods had nowhere left to go.
nowhere.zh: 整片社区被拆除，住在那些地方的人们无处可去。

nowhere.en: The islands were home to animals, found nowhere else in the world.
nowhere.zh: 这些岛屿上生活着世界上其他地方找不到的动物。

nowhere.en: For the elderly, the chronically ill, and the very young, there was often nowhere else to go.
nowhere.zh: 对于老年人、慢性病患者和极幼小的儿童来说，往往无处可去。

nonetheless.en: Nonetheless, I'm not saying that Steve Jobs doesn't merit his reputation as really one of the great consumer tech visionaries of the last century.
nonetheless.zh: 尽管如此，我并不是说史蒂夫·乔布斯配不上他作为上个世纪伟大消费科技远见者之一的声誉。

nonetheless.en: It is, I should stress, simply a theory, but an interesting one nonetheless, that the first human couples got together and stayed together in order to protect their dinner.
nonetheless.zh: 我必须强调，这只是一种理论，但尽管如此，它很有趣，即第一批人类伴侣走到一起并保持在一起是为了保护他们的晚餐。

northeast.en: And people in northeast England and South Wales had been burning it in small quantities for generations.
northeast.zh: 英格兰东北部和南威尔士的人们世世代代一直在小批量地燃烧它。

northeast.en: In the southeast of the country, the most prosperous region of England, the life expectancy at birth is 80.1, whereas in the northeast, where it is lowest, it is 77.2.
northeast.zh: 在英格兰最繁华的东南部地区，出生时的预期寿命为80.1岁，而在寿命最短的东北部地区，仅为77.2岁。

northeast.en: Wherever this line was, it was also not a straight line but one that went northeast at an almost 45-degree angle, so, strangely enough, some “northern” cities were further south than “southern” cities.
northeast.zh: 无论这条线在哪里，它都不是一条直线，而是以接近45度的角度向东北延伸，因此奇怪的是，有些“北方”城市实际上比“南方”城市还要靠南。

nominate.en: More than 100 famous monuments and historical sites were nominated from around the world.
nominate.zh: 来自世界各地的100多个著名古迹和历史遗址被提名。

nominate.en: A few years ago when this great Australian novelist named Gerald Murnane learned that he was nominated, he asked that his name be withdrawn from consideration.
nominate.zh: 几年前，当这位伟大的澳大利亚小说家 Gerald Murnane 得知自己被提名时，他要求撤回对他的提名资格。

nominate.en: He nominated a woman who had never worked in, volunteered in, ever stepped foot in a public school until he chose her to be his Secretary of Education.
nominate.zh: 他提名了一位从未在公立学校工作过、做过志愿者、甚至从未踏足过公立学校的女性，直到他选择她担任教育部长。

nominate.en: Clearly, a lot can change and no doubt will change between now and November 2028, but were Vance to be nominated, and were he to win, he would become the President of the United States at the age of just 44, making him one of the youngest presidents in US history.
nominate.zh: 显然，从现在到2028年11月之间，很多事情可能会也毫无疑问会发生变化，但如果 Vance 获得提名并赢得大选，他在44岁时就将成为美国总统，这使他成为美国历史上最年轻的总统之一。

norm.en: And what had once been a luxury of the Victorian upper classes became a global norm.
norm.zh: 曾经属于维多利亚时代上流社会的奢侈品，变成了全球的常态。

norm.en: You now no longer have societal norms or assistance or role models or archetypes or expectations.
norm.zh: 你不再拥有社会规范、援助、榜样、原型或期望。

norm.en: As was the norm with Victorian explorers, he recorded everything in a diary, and published it on his return.
norm.zh: 正如维多利亚时代探险家的常态一样，他在日记中记录了一切，并在归来后将其出版。

norm.en: At his chess matches, he frequently violated the social norms of the game, arriving late and refusing to make eye contact with the player sitting across from him.
norm.zh: 在比赛中，他常常违反棋坛的社交礼仪，迟到，还拒绝与坐在对面的棋手有任何眼神接触。

norm.en: I see this with a lot of people. I think that it contributes to a lot more of why and how people adopt societal norms, the resentment that they have.
norm.zh: 我在很多人身上都看到了这一点。我认为这在很大程度上解释了人们为什么以及如何采纳社会规范，以及他们所怀有的怨恨。

noted.en: He's noted for the fact that he doesn't like to travel.
noted.zh: 他以不喜欢旅行而闻名。

noted.en: They used a technique called forensic linguistics, which is the study of language in a legal context, and the experts noted identical usages of certain uncommon words and specific, idiosyncratic grammatical constructions.
noted.zh: 他们使用了一种叫做司法语言学（forensic linguistics）的技术，这是在法律背景下对语言的研究，专家们注意到某些不常见词汇的相同用法以及特定的、独特的语法结构。

noted.en: Brilliant. So Christopher Hitchens, one of the new atheists, was sat in some British pub with Douglas Murray when Douglas is young and you know you can imagine it's some musty Chesterfield sofa he's probably got a cigarette in his mouth and a glass of scotch or something and uh Douglas is vacillating between these two different choices that he needs to make and he is um complaining lamenting the fact that I have this thing but I have this thing and if I do this thing I can't do this thing and and what what do i do and apparently hitch like sat back and douglas in life we must choose our regrets and i was like fuck so i'm three manhattans deep in douglas murray's apartment in manhattan at two in the morning and he sneaks off to the toilet and i quickly write this down because i know that my like half cut alcohol brain isn't going to remember it so i've noted down.
noted.zh: 太精彩了。克里斯托弗·希钦斯，新无神论者之一，有一次在一家英国酒吧里，和年轻时的道格拉斯·穆雷坐在一起，你可以想象那是一个发霉的切斯特菲尔德沙发，他嘴里可能叼着一支烟，手里端着一杯苏格兰威士忌什么的，然后啊，道格拉斯正在他需要做出的两个不同选择之间举棋不定，他正在，呃，抱怨、哀叹着说：我既有这个机会，又有那个机会，如果我选了这个，就没法选那个，然后，我到底该怎么办啊？据说希钦往后一靠，说道：“道格拉斯，在生活中，我们必须选择我们的遗憾。”我当时想：我靠！当时我在曼哈顿道格拉斯·穆雷的公寓里，已经喝了三杯曼哈顿鸡尾酒，时间是凌晨两点，他悄悄溜去洗手间，我赶紧把这话记下来，因为我知道我那半醉的酒精大脑根本记不住，所以我把它记了下来。

nod.en: Simple nonverbal signals matter. Eye contact, nodding, and small reactions show that you are engaged.
nod.zh: 简单的非语言信号也很重要。眼神接触、点头以及细微的反应都表明你很投入。

nod.en: And he just, he didn't even respond. He just took, he just like pursed his lips and nodded.
nod.zh: 他甚至没有回应。他只是抿了抿嘴，点了点头。

nod.en: I know some cultures don’t necessarily like eye contact or nodding, or have different ways of showing you are engaged.
nod.zh: 我知道某些文化未必喜欢眼神接触或点头，或者有不同的方式来表达你的投入。

nod.en: A single wave of his hand or nod of his head and anyone in Rome, no matter how powerful, would be put to their death.
nod.zh: 他只需挥一下手或点一下头，罗马的任何人，无论多么权势熏天，都会被处以死刑。

nod.en: He turned and said, "What do you suppose, except that at a single nod of mine, both of you could have your throats cut on the spot?"
nod.zh: 他转过身说：“你们觉得呢，除了只要我点一下头，你们两个的喉咙当场就会被割断之外？”

notification.en: This involves pinging people at random times of the day, with a text, an app notification, or even a beeper back in the 1980s, and asking: “How are you feeling right now?
notification.zh: 这种方法包括在一天中的随机时间给人们发送短信、应用通知，或者在 20 世纪 80 年代使用寻呼机，然后询问：“你现在感觉怎么样？

noble.en: The population grew. Wealthy nobles built grand palaces and elegant residences in Warsaw.
noble.zh: 人口增长了。富有的贵族们在华沙建造了宏伟的宫殿和优雅的宅邸。

noble.en: They also had a complex social hierarchy that organized society into nobles, warriors, priests, and farmers.
noble.zh: 他们还拥有复杂的社会等级制度，将社会组织为贵族、武士、祭司和农民。

noble.en: One politician, and man of noble blood, Atanius Secundus, had what he must have thought was a cunning idea.
noble.zh: 有一位政治家、出身高贵的 Atanius Secundus 想到了一个他自己认为是精明的主意。

noble.en: The British Royal Navy protected a fleet of boats carrying parts of Portugal’s royal family, royal officials, nobles, soldiers, servants, and thousands of other people.
noble.zh: 英国皇家海军护送着一支船队，船上载有葡萄牙王室成员、皇室官员、贵族、士兵、仆从以及成千上万的其他民众。

noble.en: It got endorsements from the pope, and wealthy Christian nobles handed over their fortunes to the order, to help it continue its holy mission of enabling Europeans to make this dangerous pilgrimage safely.
noble.zh: 它得到了教皇的背书，富有的基督教贵族将他们的财富交给了该修会，以帮助其继续完成使欧洲人能够安全进行这次危险朝圣的神圣使命。

northwards.en: Instead of taking the quickest route, by ship, he had marched his men northwards, up through Spain and southern France.
northwards.zh: 他没有选择坐船走最快的路线，而是率领部下一路向北，穿越西班牙和法国南部。

northwards.en: One account has him marching his troops northwards, as if to attack Great Britain, but after lining his troops up on the beach in Gaul, he orders them to collect seashells instead of continue their mission, declaring these the “spoils of the ocean”.
northwards.zh: 有一个记载说，他率领军队向北行进，仿佛要进攻英国，但在高卢的海滩上排好军队后，他却命令他们去收集贝壳而不是继续任务，并宣称这些是“海洋的战利品”。

notorious.en: Had he done so, and had he been unmasked as the notorious “El Aurens,” as the Arabs called him, he would almost certainly have been shot.
notorious.zh: 如果他透露了身份，或者被揭穿是阿拉伯人所称的那个臭名昭著的“El Aurens”，他几乎肯定会被枪毙。

notorious.en: That occupation was extremely harsh. One of the most notorious events was the Sook Ching Massacre, during which the Japanese military carried out mass killings of people suspected of being anti-Japanese, especially among Singapore’s Chinese population.
notorious.zh: 那次占领极其残酷。最臭名昭著的事件之一是肃清大屠杀（Sook Ching Massacre），期间日本军方对被怀疑是反日分子的人展开了大规模杀戮，特别是在新加坡的华人人口中。

notion.en: "And so, he juxtaposes this notion of inevitability--which could be technological inevitability.
notion.zh: 于是他把这种必然性的观念并置在一起——这种必然性可以是技术上的必然性。

notion.en: And, it also borrows from this notion of innovation being fundamentally combinatorial.
notion.zh: 这篇论文同样借鉴了“创新在本质上是组合性的”这一理念。

notion.en: I feel angry for you. You know, I'm just like, the whole notion that you would say like, you know me, I wouldn't do this.
